headword: {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}

definitions.gloss: two-generation house; duplex home for parents and children
definitions.explanation: A house designed for two households of one family, usually the parents and a married child's family, often with separate kitchens, bathrooms, or entrances.

examples.japanese: {二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I live with my parents in a two-generation house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二世帯住宅|にせたいじゅうたく}なら、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: In a two-generation house with separate entrances, neither household has to get in the other's way.

notes:
⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (two) + ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (household) + ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (house). The two households share one building but keep some or all of their living space apart.
